newsitem.title: UK: De La Rue up on favourable press.
newsitem.headline: De La Rue up on favourable press.

text.p: Shares in banknote printer De La Rue Plc hit an eight-month high on Friday after a press report highlighted recent strength in the stock, said to reflect a recent chart breakout and hopes for better profit margins.
The stock was up 9p at 670 by 0901 GMT in volume of 115,159 shares, after earlier rising as high as 674p -- its highest since June last year.
A report in the Independent newspaper said chartists had noted a "golden cross" where the 38-day moving average in the shares had crossed the 200-day moving average.

It also said the planned introduction of the "euro" - the European Union's single currency -- in 1999 was expected to keep rivals in Europe busy, creating higher margins in its key third-world markets.
